signals.content: The defense acquisition system builds tanks and aircraft over decades. Software fielded that way arrives obsolete. Project Maven skipped the process entirely. Eight months after its creation, AI-enabled computer vision was operating in combat, refined by operator feedback instead of laboratory testing. The Pentagon's institutional machinery fought it at every turn, and the team fought back harder. Katrina Manson captured how that happened. Full review at The Military Reading Room. Link in bio.
